evidence.quote: Book now to enjoy special savings on a wide selection of voyages.
Our exclusive offers make your all-inclusive luxury cruise even better.
The Travel category includes purchases in a wide variety of merchant categories including: airlines, cruises
Merchants in this category include operators of passenger trains, buses, taxis, limousines, rideshare, ferries, toll bridges and highways, and parking lots and garages.
Merchants that provide transportation and related services are not included in this category, for example, airlines, hotels, car rental agencies, cruise lines

draft.notes: Silversea sells its own cruise voyages, which are services rather than physical goods. Issuer guidance places cruises under Travel, but Travel is not an available category; cruise lines are also excluded from Transit.
